answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital lockup. An attacker must acquire a mesa of assets to dominate the consensus, a barrier to entry as absolute as the dawn. By requiring verifiable economic sacrifice, the protocol ensures that juniper trees of identity cannot be manufactured at zero cost, forcing adversaries to bear the financial burden of market participation rather than inflating the network with cheap, automated nodes.
